subject: maths
question: The ratio of the number of boys to that of girls in a village is 5 : 3. If 40% of the boys and 60% of the girls appeared in an examination, then the ratio of the number of boys and girls who appeared in the examination to the number who did not appear in the same examination, is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the number of boys = 500 and girls = 300 (Total = 800).

Appeared students = (40% of 500) + (60% of 300) = 200 + 180 = 380.

Did not appear students = Total − Appeared = 800 − 380 = 420.

Required Ratio = 380 : 420 = 19 : 21.

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Boys to Girls = 5 : 3

Percentage of boys appeared = 40%

Percentage of girls appeared = 60%

**Formula Used:**

Percentage Value = (Percentage/100) × Total Value

 Boys (Ratio 5) 
• Appeared (40%) Not Appeared (60%) Girls (Ratio 3) 
• Appeared (60%) Not App (40%) Ratio = Total Appeared : Total Not Appeared 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let total boys = 500 and total girls = 300.

⇒ Number of boys who appeared = 40% of 500 = 200.

⇒ Number of girls who appeared = 60% of 300 = 180.

⇒ Total students who appeared = 200 + 180 = 380.

⇒ Number of boys who did not appear = 60% of 500 = 300.

⇒ Number of girls who did not appear = 40% of 300 = 120.

⇒ Total students who did not appear = 300 + 120 = 420.

⇒ Required Ratio = Total Appeared : Total Not Appeared

⇒ Ratio = 380 : 420

⇒ Dividing both sides by 20 ⇒ 19 : 21.

**∴ The correct option is B.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average for Percentages

The overall percentage can be calculated as (n₁×p₁ + n₂×p₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂), where n is the ratio part and p is the percentage.

Complementary Percentages

If x% of a population satisfies a condition, then (100 − x)% of that population does not satisfy it.

Simplifying Ratios

A ratio a : b remains unchanged if both terms are multiplied or divided by the same non-zero number.
